threat.description: Critical CORS vulnerability. Server allows requests from ANY origin (*). This enables cross-site attacks and data theft.
threat.evidence: Response contains 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *'
threat.mitigation: Restrict CORS to specific trusted origins.

threat.description: JWT token validation vulnerability. Tampered token accepted. Signature not properly verified.
threat.evidence: Tampered token accepted without proper validation.
threat.mitigation: Ensure proper signature verification for JWT tokens.

threat.description: SQL injection successful using payload. Response indicates successful authentication.
threat.evidence: Response contains 'success' or 'token' after injection payload.
threat.mitigation: Use prepared statements and parameterized queries to prevent SQL injection.

threat.description: XSS vulnerability detected. Payload reflected in response without proper encoding.
threat.evidence: Payload '<script>alert('XSS')</script>' reflected in response.
threat.mitigation: Sanitize and encode user inputs to prevent XSS.

threat.description: Information leakage detected. Different responses allow user enumeration.
threat.evidence: Invalid user response differs from valid user response.
threat.mitigation: Ensure consistent responses for valid and invalid usernames.

threat.description: Path traversal vulnerability detected. System files accessible.
threat.evidence: Response contains sensitive file content.
threat.mitigation: Validate and sanitize file paths to prevent path traversal.

threat.description: Weak password policy detected. Weak passwords accepted.
threat.evidence: Accepted weak password: '123456'.
threat.mitigation: Enforce strong password policies requiring complexity.

threat.description: Session fixation vulnerability detected. Session ID not regenerated after authentication.
threat.evidence: Same session ID used before and after login.
threat.mitigation: Regenerate session ID upon successful login.

threat.description: Missing security headers increase risk of attacks.
threat.evidence: Missing headers: X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, etc.
threat.mitigation: Implement essential security headers in HTTP responses.

threat.description: Rate limiting detected. Blocked after multiple attempts.
threat.evidence: Response indicates rate limiting after several login attempts.
threat.mitigation: Implement account lockout mechanisms and rate limiting.

threat.description: Application lacks immutable audit logging; actions can be performed without a traceable record.
threat.mitigation: Implement tamper-evident, append-only audit logs with timestamps and user context.

threat.description: Database passwords and API keys are stored in plaintext within configuration files.
threat.mitigation: Move secrets to environment variables or a secrets manager.
